caught.speaker: ada
caught.text: I hear say you catch Bíọ́dún for road this morning. Ah-ah, you wan kill the man? E get five pikin o.

escaped.speaker: ada
escaped.text: Bíọ́dún dey tell everybody for park say JJC no fit run. Dem dey laugh you since morning.

let_go.speaker: ada
let_go.text: Bíọ́dún say you be good person. That one go remember you, you hear?

bought.speaker: professor
bought.text: That tea wey you buy me this morning... e sweet. Rule One: never forget who buy you tea. I no go forget.

refused.speaker: professor
refused.text: You no buy me tea this morning. No wahala. Street go teach you manners, I no need to.

paid.speaker: professor
paid.text: And next time person sell you ticket for bus stop, come ask me first. That ₦500 for your hand na my gift to you. The lesson na your own.

questioned.speaker: professor
questioned.text: You ask that thief for ID card this morning. Hahaha! I like am. Small sense dey your head. Keep am there, Lagos go try collect am.

dodged.speaker: professor
dodged.text: That your fake phone call this morning... e good. Lagos na stage play. Everybody dey act. Make sure say you know your own script.
